title: The Madmen Of China And Their Hatred For Black People

sense.text:
“Search the scriptures”: that is our job. All nations do not search the scriptures. They leave their scripture searching to Matthew through Revelation, with the misunderstanding that comes from Christianity.

Start from Genesis and you will find that salvation, and rulership of the earth, is only for the Israelites through Christ.

precepts.why:
The people of Berea “were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.”

When Paul presented them the truth of Christ, they searched the scriptures daily to see whether what Paul was teaching was accurate according to the scriptures. That is what we have to do.

“It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.” When God conceals something, it is in parable form, in metaphors and allegories, and it is our job to figure out what the Lord means by it.

“The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever.” What God kept secret and then revealed to us is for our children and our children’s children forever.

So what we bring out of the scriptures is meant for our sons and our daughters. Teach them. Don’t let this truth fall by the wayside and your sons and daughters end up worshipping Caesar Borgia all over again. That would be a detriment to you and your family.

An example of why we must search: “Against Moab thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled”. Unless you search the scriptures and pray to the Lord, you read that and say, I don’t know who Moab is, and just move on to the next chapter.

“Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the Lord; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?” The one who does not search says, I don’t know who the Ammonites are, and I don’t know who Gad is, I’m just confused, so I’ll stick to Matthew through Revelation. That is what the churches do.

So they stay confused and discombobulated by the names of these nations, never able to identify who they are today. Christians don’t know. Muslims don’t know.

“And thou, Asia, that art partaker of the hope of Babylon, and art the glory of her person”. Examine who Asia is: this is speaking of East Asia, whose primary countries and territories are China, Japan, South Korea, North Korea, Mongolia and Taiwan.

That is searching the scriptures: finding out who these nations are today.

sense.text:
The angry Chinese woman made a point of saying that seven black jurors found Mr. Chow not guilty. I wonder why. And the boy did not steal any water: he left his bag at the front, went to the water, put it back, and was walking out when they told him to check his pockets, and he had nothing in them.

There were “ungodly persons, who hated their own people,” who went unto the king and told on Jonathan. We always had a certain remnant of our people who love other races better than their own. You have negroes out there, Christians, who hate their own people. What was true back then in the time of the Maccabees is true today.

Sodom and Gomorrah have just been destroyed. Lot’s wife was turned to a pillar of salt because she looked back: she had LGBT friends and a lot of substance there, and God killed her. So now it is just Lot and his two daughters, and “he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.”
“There is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth”: they think everybody on the planet is dead.

They made their father drink wine and lay with him, first the firstborn and then the younger: “Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.”

If you have sex and children with your father, oftentimes, not 100%, there is a genetic mutation that comes from that union. It is called mongoloidism. Look at the traits, the eye traits. That is a trait of incest many, many times.

“The firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.” The younger bare Ben-ammi, “the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.”

Back in the ’90s, coming into the truth, our elders already taught that Moab was the Chinese and Ammon was the Japanese. Only recently were books found that say the same. The Japanese: Who Are They? by Thomas W. Plant holds that the Japanese are the children of Ammon, that Japan and China are Ben-ammi and Moab of old, and that proving Japan to be the children of Ammon carries with it the claim that the Chinese are the children of Moab. We had it first; this came way later.

Genetically, Koreans are slightly closer to the Japanese than to the Chinese: so write it down, the Koreans, South and North, are Ammonites. The Vietnamese are significantly closer to the Chinese: the Vietnamese are Moab, so it ain’t just China. And Mongolia is genetically closer to China than to Japan: Mongolia is Moab.

precepts.why:
“We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.”

In the book The Dragon, Image, and Demon, on the three religions of China (Confucianism, Buddhism and Taoism), this very verse is written out with China in the place of Moab: the pride of China, exceeding proud. Moab was translated to China. Moab is China.

sense.text: “The burden of Moab.” Ar and Kir are cities of Moab, laid waste in the night. This took place under Nebuchadnezzar, when Babylon came in smiting Moab. But there is a dual significance behind it, because there is a spiritual Babylon that will do it again.

“Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.” Moab has a thing that when they are in great sorrow or mourning, they shave all their hair off. It is one of their customs, in their religions.

In Chinese religious tradition, head shaving is not required of lay followers, but it is an absolute obligation for ordained monastics, the monks and nuns. In the Buddhist tradition the shaving of the head carries great meaning: it marks those who leave the household life.

precepts.why: “And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city”. The dead bodies are the spiritually dead bodies of the Israelites, and the great city is Babylon the Great.

“Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.” This place, America, is a spiritual Babylon. It is not the actual Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar, but God calls this place Babylon the great.

So when Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar smote Moab in Isaiah 15, know that there is a dual significance behind it: Babylon the great will come upon Moab again.

sense.text: “Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela”: Sela is Petra, and Petra is Edom. They call Edom Petra today. “Unto the mount of the daughter of Zion” points to the Israelites.

“Hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.” The outcast is us, the Israelites. That is why verse 1 says “unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.” During the time of Nebuchadnezzar, many Israelites fled and hid amongst Moab.
“Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler”. The spoiler was Nebuchadnezzar at that time. There is a dual meaning behind these scriptures.

“And in mercy shall the throne be established”: the throne that is going to be established is the throne of Christ, who “shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.”

“We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud”. If you didn’t know the Chinese man was proud, you learned it these last few weeks with Mr. Chow, and with the angry Asian lady. That is called pride. The young boy left his bag at the door, went to check for water, put the water back and left the store. They followed behind him, chased him for 130 yards and shot the boy in the back. Why was he running? Because he was scared. He is a boy, with two grown men chasing behind him.

“But his lies shall not be so”: it is all going to be shut down.

precepts.why: “All the Jews that were in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, and that were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah”. Where were they? In Moab. This shows what Isaiah 16 is speaking of: in the days of Nebuchadnezzar the Israelites, the outcasts, were dwelling in Moab and among the Ammonites.

“For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder”: the government shall be upon the shoulders of Christ. His name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace. A lot of people don’t understand why he is called the everlasting Father: the one you think was the heavenly Father in the Old Testament was actually Christ. That is why there is a lot of confusion in the Israelite community.

Here is the point: “Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David”, the same throne of Isaiah 16:5. And it is “to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice”. That is law and order.

Why do some black people say, I just don’t like law and order? Because you like chaos. Some black men and women love a chaotic marriage, a chaotic life. Toxic is the word. It goes back way back: it is genetic encoding from slavery, in your DNA, in all of us. But the Bible can break that, only if you let it. If you relish in that lifestyle, that is why you are married today and divorced tomorrow, and you hate your kids because the kid looks like the daddy that left you. Only God can cleanse that from you.

Why does Isaiah say “Of the increase of his government”? Because “The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field: Which indeed is the least of all seeds”. The mustard seed is one of the smallest of all seeds, and that is how the kingdom of heaven is on earth. “But when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.” Grown is the increase. All nations are going to submit and follow it.

We are at that mustard seed stage now. Some say that Israelite thing ain’t nothing. Oh no, it is something: this is the beginning of God’s government. This is why we establish law and order, rank and order, and teach the brothers and sisters the laws, commandments and statutes of the Holy Bible. Some of you don’t like law because you like adultery better. Shame on you. You don’t like order, you like disorder: that is genetic encoding from slavery. Some of y’all need white man therapy. We can’t help all of you, but those who submit to the word of God, we can help.

And it is only going to increase. Check the history from the time of Nat Turner: you thought it ended there, but it didn’t. Look at the history of the Israelite schools. IUIC is part of that great history, part of that mustard seed that, when it is grown, is the greatest of all. You are not tricking us back into worshipping white Jesus.

sense.text: “Against Moab”: remember, Moab is China, and the Vietnamese are Moab as well. Nebo was a city there; Kiriathaim was another great city, “confounded and taken” by Nebuchadnezzar.

“There shall be no more praise of Moab”. Black people praise Moab, especially Bruce Lee. Back in the day everybody was kung fu fighting. We love those Chinese movies, and we will praise Moab quick, but Moab don’t have that same love for us. In Georgia our people were praising Moab and walking with them. Our people are sick.

Even today people say the next world superpower is going to be China, but the prophecy says there shall be no more praise of Moab: “come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen”. See what God calls Moab: madmen. When you read the history of Moab, they hated our people, despised us, and would kill us at random.

“Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.” Nebuchadnezzar destroyed Moab at that time, as Jeremiah prophesied. But there is duality to this: Moab today, China, is a world superpower, and they will be destroyed once again.
Some of them fled up the hill, “the going up of Luhith”, and some went down into the valley of Horonaim, and “the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.” Moab was being destroyed.

God told Moab, “Flee, save your lives”. Why? “Because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures”: Moab always trusted in their works. “Thou shalt also be taken”: taken into captivity means slavery, prisoners of war. Chemosh was the favorite idol of Moab that they worshipped, and he “shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.”

“The spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape”. The spoiler was Nebuchadnezzar at that time, and just like back then, it shall be so today. Write it down: this goes with 2 Esdras 15:46-61, which tells of the destruction of Asia and Babylon.

“Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away”: that it may escape Nebuchadnezzar. When Nebuchadnezzar went through there, they fled, and not just from that area: they fled far east. Some got caught, and some did not.

precepts.why:
This speaks of the Greeks, Antiochus Epiphanes in particular. “He shall enter also into the glorious land”, the land of Israel, “and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.”

There was a remnant of Edom that did not join the Greeks or Rome. And Moab was still there in that time: not everybody left when Nebuchadnezzar came; some were still there, and there were remnants of the Ammonites still there too.

“Jason slew his own citizens without mercy”: Jason was a wicked Israelite who went against his own people, a wretch who “received shame for the reward of his treason, and fled again into the country of the Ammonites.” Then he was “accused before Aretas the king of the Arabians”. Why before the king of the Arabians? Because the Arabs controlled the land of the Ammonites.

Josephus, in the Antiquities of the Jews (book 13, chapter 15), shows the same for Moab: in the days of the Hasmonean king Alexander Jannaeus, he was forced to deliver back to the king of Arabia the land of Moab and Gilead. Those were the Nabataeans, and the Nabataeans were Arabs. That is why foolish people online say Edom are the Arabs: when you look up Edom it says ruled by the Nabataeans. But the Nabataeans came later, in the time of the Maccabees.

The Moabites and Ammonites left their lands in increments, from the time of Nebuchadnezzar all the way to the time of the Greeks, under Babylon, Persia-Media, the Greeks and Rome, and the Arabs took over the land. The research that says they vanished and simply blended into the Arabs is a lie. They did walk away. Amalek controls ChatGPT and Google, and they will mislead you on purpose so that you never find out who Moab and Ammon are.

sense.text:
“For was not Israel a derision unto thee?” The Israelites were a derision unto Moab. “For since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.” They were happy, skipping for joy. Why? Because they destroyed us. Moab helped destroy us.

In China, in their monasteries and in the caves, the walls are full of black images, Africans diving for pearls. Your Chinese friends won’t tell you about any of this; they’ll play stupid. All nations stick together except dumb black people: the Chinese will have a meeting and won’t invite one negro, but black people have a meeting and there is always one negro bringing in Miss Chow or Mr. Chow. It is just like Rome, with the black images in the catacombs and the churches: they have all these black images, and they hate and despise us.

“Set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them”. Remember, Ammon is the Japanese and the Koreans, North and South. In order to prophesy against them, you must first be able to identify who they are.

“Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity”. They laughed at and mocked the sanctuary of God Almighty. Ammon mocked us and laughed at us when we went into slavery, when our sanctuary was profaned.
“I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession”. That started with Nebuchadnezzar, followed by Persia-Media. They were catching hell. But the party ain’t over.

“Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen”. Moab is China, the Vietnamese and Mongolia; Seir is Edom. The Chinese and the white man said the house of Judah is like all the heathen: there is nothing special about them.
“I will open the side of Moab from the cities”: like when you fight and cut somebody on the side, God is going to have the side of Moab, his cities on his frontiers, destroyed.

“Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites”: this came because of Nebuchadnezzar, and like the rest, these scriptures have a dual meaning, “that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.”
“And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am the Lord.”

“Why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?” Historically, when Gad was moved out of the land, Ammon moved into our land. That is what happened.

On the ancient map, Manasseh, Gad and Reuben lie east of the Jordan, and Ammon is right next to Gad. When Gad was moved out of the land by the Assyrian captivity, Ammon moved back in. Then Nebuchadnezzar began to move them out, then came Persia, then the Greeks, and in the time of the Greeks the Arabs had the land of Ammon.

On today’s map you see Amman, spelled A-M-M-A-N instead of O-N. That is the Ammon of the Bible, in what America calls Jordan. That is all Arab land now, but it was Ammon’s and Moab’s land. How did the Arabs get it? Nebuchadnezzar started to push them out, and the Greeks made a deal with the Arabs and gave them the land of Ammon and Moab.

“I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites”: Rabbah is a city in Ammon. “Her daughters shall be burned with fire”: Nebuchadnezzar burned their daughters with fire. “Then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the Lord.”

precepts.why:
“For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border”. When they caught our people they ripped up the women with child: they hung them upside down, just like the white man did to us, cut their stomachs so the baby fell out, and crushed the babies on their heads. That is what the Bible says they did. God is not forgiving them for that; he is not letting them slide on what they did to the women of Gilead. They slaughtered Gad, because they wanted to take over our lands.

“But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle”: there is a day of battle coming, “with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind”, and that is the Lord.

“And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together”. Look at Kim Jong-un, the leader of North Korea. Whoever is the leader of the land of Ammon today, he is going to be a prisoner of war. That is what the prophecy says, so just look for it.

What does it mean, “then shall Israel be heir”? “And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.” We are joint heirs with Christ.

“And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau”: we are going to own Esau. “And they of the plain the Philistines”: we are going to own them as well. “They shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria”: we are going to get our lands back. “And Benjamin shall possess Gilead”: God foretells that the tribe of Benjamin will dwell in the land of Gilead.

The history of what happened when we entered the land: Moses already had it mapped out for us. “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the Lord, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession”. And “the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it”.

So Gad, Reuben and Manasseh had that land, Gilead, the land Ammon later moved into. But in the prophecy of Obadiah, God says that in the future he is going to give that land to Benjamin.

sense.text:
Books on the history of Japan show the black faces in Japan in the 1400s and 1500s, brought as slaves by the Portuguese and Spanish. They were the workers, carrying loads on their shoulders and carrying their masters on their backs, the same thing we had to do for the white folks over here. In China they called us Kunlun: the first Africans came to China as tribute gifts during the Tang dynasty, and African slavery in China peaked during the Tang and Song dynasties. The Portuguese brought enslaved Africans to Macau in large numbers in the 1500s, and they were made soldiers, bodyguards and servants, and the women concubines. They also called us Zanj. You don’t learn this in school, and you definitely don’t learn it in Sunday school; they make deals with these countries to keep this history secret, and brothers had to go to other countries to dig these books up. We were slaves there too, and that is why nobody wants to give us reparations: all nations have got to pay.

Even a book from 1912, Who’s Who in Philadelphia, by Charles Fred White, says that Hannibal was of Ethiopian blood, that King Solomon proudly acknowledged he was black, and that Jesus Christ himself was as much a Negro as some of the race you persecuted. They knew.

In case somebody gets stupid: “And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other”. We were scattered everywhere, and that includes, as we are finding out, China and Japan.

“And thou, Asia”: this is talking about East Asia, “that art partaker of the hope of Babylon, and art the glory of her person.” They are the glory of the person of Babylon; they always want to be like Babylon.

What happened to all those black Jews, the slaves of the diaspora during those dynasties? One book on the ancient Jewish diaspora in Japan says the Great Wall of China was built by the hands of Jewish captives: not just reinforced, built. Those captives were brutally oppressed by Chinese kings, who treated us like Pharaoh in Egypt, and some escaped to Japan by way of Korea. Another holds that the name samurai recalls ancient Samaria: once the Israelites were exiled, early immigrants to Japan were carved clothed like the ancient Assyrians, the samurai kept rites like those of the Jews, such as the redemption of the firstborn, Japanese priests wore something like the phylacteries, and the six-pointed star of David is common in Japan. The old proverb said that to be a good samurai, a fighting servant, one must have half black blood in one’s veins. They made some of us their military, their bodyguards: we were their samurai. What happened to us? 2 Esdras 15 tells it.

“Woe be unto thee, thou wretch, because thou hast made thyself like unto her”: Asia has made herself like Babylon the great. “And hast decked thy daughters in whoredom, that they might please and glory in thy lovers”: this goes into their corporations. The whoredom is the fornication with all nations, the business deals.

“Thou hast followed her that is hated in all her works and inventions”. This is how you know it is China and Japan. Who is hated? Babylon the great is hated. In all of America’s works and inventions, China either reverse engineered it or stole the technology, and Japan too.

“I will send plagues upon thee; widowhood, poverty, famine, sword, and pestilence, to waste thy houses with destruction and death.” That is the judgment that is coming. Remember, this is a prophecy that has not occurred yet. That is why there are dual meanings in Jeremiah 48 and 49 and Isaiah 15 and 16: this is the proof.

Listen to what God says about them: “If thou hadst not always slain my chosen”. That is why there are no black people over in China and Japan: they were always killing us. That is what God prophesied.

“And saying over their dead, when thou wast drunken, Set forth the beauty of thy countenance”. Imagine it: they would have their parties, everybody drinking and getting drunk, the bodyguards drunk, the samurai drunk. That was their opportunity: they are drunk now, kill them. And the Japanese and the Chinese would slaughter us. They said we had great physical power, but they couldn’t get us one-on-one, so they said, let’s get them drunk.

“Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity”. Emptied from vessel to vessel means being taken captive and brought from one slavery to the next slavery to the next, like we were. That did not happen to Moab. “Therefore his taste remained in him”: his hatred. “And his scent is not changed”: they have not changed from their beginning till now.
“I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels”: Nebuchadnezzar came.
“And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh”. Chemosh was their god. They always had a lot of gods, but Chemosh was their favorite.

precepts.why:
What is it, “as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth–el their confidence”? Jeroboam “made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel”. “And he set the one in Beth–el, and the other put he in Dan.” We had two calves, and our people were worshipping them.

He “made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.” And he “ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah”: the feast of tabernacles was kept on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, but Jeroboam of the northern kingdom made his own, “in the month which he had devised of his own heart”.

Look at the gods of China today: the one with the horns, Chinese myth gods with horns just like Baal, a cow god, a cow’s head carved in stone. Israel was ashamed of its calves, and Moab shall be ashamed of its gods.

sense.text:
“How say ye, We are mighty and strong men for the war?” Moab always says that they are mighty and strong men. They have order, I give them that, with their four-foot selves.

Do the elites of America know who China is? The Guardian reported America using the mother of all bombs, which they call MOAB, in Afghanistan, and that is the bomb they say they would use if they ever fight China. Why did they choose that name? Is it a coincidence? We don’t believe in coincidences.

Moab thinks they can defeat anybody, but “his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts.” Although Moab was a strong nation, God said he would have Nebuchadnezzar destroy them. And chapter 48 has a dual meaning, for the last days.
“The calamity of Moab is near to come”. “Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon”: Dibon was a city in Moab. Today they call the land of Moab and Ammon Jordan, where the Arabs are.
Aroer is another city that was in Moab, in what is called Jordan today. “Say, What is done?” What happened? “Moab is confounded; for it is broken down”: Moab is destroyed. Arnon is a city in Moab.
Judgment comes upon the plain country, upon Holon, Jahazah, Mephaath, Dibon, Nebo and the rest: more cities in modern-day Jordan, “and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.”
“The horn of Moab is cut off”: their power, their leader.
“Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the Lord”. Make Moab drunk. Why does God say make them drunk? Because that is what they did to us.

“For was not Israel a derision unto thee?” Didn’t you do that to the Israelites? “For since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.” You danced when you slaughtered us; you were so happy when we fell, when you killed us. So now God is saying they are going to be judged.

See how they mock us in China: a laundry soap commercial that aired there, in which they mock us, and which many accused of whitewashing. And believe it or not, some black people see nothing wrong with that. That is why we still have some who want to date them, marry them and have kids by them.

“O ye that dwell in Moab”, that is China, “leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole’s mouth.” That is talking about bunkers. China has bunkers in their mountains: little bunkers, big bunkers, all kinds of bunkers.

“We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud)”. “I know his wrath, saith the Lord; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.”

They are so proud. Their spokesman says China will not fire the first shot but will not allow you to fire the second, boasts of a missile that carries sixty nuclear warheads and a hydrogen bomb and can reach every corner of the world in under twenty minutes, and says that if you want to destroy China you will be destroyed. That is pride. Whatever China says, God says it shall not be so: his lies will not affect the outcome of what God says is going to happen to him.

“I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the Lord, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.” China is known for lighting incense to their gods and their ancestors: so many sticks praying to Buddhas, so many to the gods of the four directions, so many to one’s father and one’s mother. That is more proof that they are Moab. And how come you don’t see fat Chinese people, but their god, Buddha, is overweight?
“For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped”. “For I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the Lord”: God is letting you know he is going to destroy Moab.
“Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.” America’s symbol is the eagle.

“The mighty men’s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs”: very fearful, scared and afraid. “And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord.” That is the prophecy.

“Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab”. They have a hidden metropolis, the underground city, a sprawling Cold War bunker beneath Beijing. They are going into the mountains and into the earth, trying to get all these safeguards, but the Lord is telling us in the scripture that it ain’t going to work.
“They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon”: Heshbon is in Jordan. This is ancient Moab, modern-day Jordan, but it is going to happen to both.
“Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth”: Chemosh is the idol. “For thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives”: prisoners of war.

“Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days”. When? In the latter days. Although it happened with Nebuchadnezzar, God said it is going to happen again in the latter days. “Thus far is the judgment of Moab.”

precepts.why:
This goes into what they did to us. Remember the subject: “And thou, Asia, that art partaker of the hope of Babylon”, East Asia in particular. “Like as thou hast done unto my chosen, saith the Lord, even so shall God do unto thee”. “Thy children shall die of hunger, and thou shalt fall through the sword: thy cities shall be broken down”.

“They that be in the mountains shall die of hunger, and eat their own flesh, and drink their own blood”: that is cannibalism, and it is those in the bunkers in the mountains. Everybody thinks they have a plan for when Armageddon comes: we will go into the bunkers and live there for a century. No, that is not going to happen.

“They shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of thy land, and consume part of thy glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.” The idle city is talking about China. And America ain’t finished yet: it is the American army that goes back and sees Babylon destroyed. Although the country America is wiped out, their military is not finished. That is why they have over 800 military bases worldwide, and America is the only country that has that. Russia doesn’t, China doesn’t: nobody but Babylon the great, the United States of America. That is how they will get China, even though their base here will be finished.

What happens to Asia: “Thy children shall they carry away captive”, prisoners of war, “and, look, what thou hast, they shall spoil it, and mar the beauty of thy face.” It answers Jeremiah: “thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.”

sense.text:
“I will liken my judgment unto a ring: like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first.” There is no slackness of the last plagues and judgments, and no swiftness of the first. It is a steady flow of judgment upon all nations.

So are we promoting harm to the Chinese? No. Some of you work for them, some go to school with them, and that is fine. Our job is to tell you what God says is going to happen to these nations: not just the Chinese, but all nations.

“Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers”. That goes for you men and women. You find people out on the street, she looks good or he looks good, I think I should marry them: you’re a fool. That goes with it: don’t be marrying these other nations either. “For what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness?” We are a righteous people, or at least we should be; God says we are.

“And what concord hath Christ with Belial?” What agreement does Christ have with those idols? “Or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?” What part do you, brothers and sisters, have with an unbeliever that worships idols?

“For ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.” God will dwell in us, walk in us, be our God, and we shall be his people.

“Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate”. Come out from among these other nations. What is that word? Separate. So why are we always trying to mingle and integrate? God says be separate from them. “And touch not the unclean thing”: don’t touch those false religions and the politics they are all in. “And I will receive you”: only then will God receive us.
“And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.”

“Moab is my washpot”: Moab is going to wash our clothes. They are going to be our laundromat forever. “Over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph”: over Palestine.

We ain’t supposed to be married to them. God says come out from among them, be ye separate. Some of y’all are of mixed parentage, and that’s fine, but find yourself an Israelite woman, an Israelite man, and don’t do this no more.

precepts.why: “But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west”: we shall fly upon the shoulders of the Palestinians. “They shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.” We shall lay our hands upon Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon, the Japanese, shall obey us.

sense.text: Nobody escapes, brothers and sisters. Nobody gets away with what they did to God’s chosen people. “I have heard the reproach of Moab”: God heard what them damn Chinese said about his people. “And the revilings of the children of Ammon”: the hatred of the Japanese, “whereby they have reproached my people”. You think they love us? God said they reproach us; they hate us. And they “magnified themselves against their border”, against the Israelites.

“Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah”: destruction upon the earth. That is nuclear fire, and this has not happened yet. “A perpetual desolation.”

“The residue of my people shall spoil them”: the remnant of God’s people is going to put them into captivity. “And the remnant of my people shall possess them.”
